title: Battle of the Little Bighorn
summary: On 25–26 June 1876 along the Little Bighorn River in south-central Montana, Lakota, Northern Cheyenne and Arapaho warriors fought the US 7th Cavalry under Lt. Col. Custer. Custer's portion of the regiment was wiped out. The US then pressed the campaign harder, and most declared hostiles surrendered within a year.

as_recorded.value: evening of June 25, 1876, to dusk on the 26th

importance.justification: Best-known battle of the Plains Indian wars, a major Lakota and Cheyenne victory that shaped later US policy.
